landing_cta_footnote: Free and open source. A fan-made tool, not affiliated with Pocketpair, Inc.
landing_desktop_body: The desktop version stays free and maintained. Choose it for maximum performance and for dedicated server features the browser cannot reach.
landing_desktop_heading: Prefer the desktop app? It is here to stay
landing_faq_a_browsers: Modern Chromium browsers and Firefox. Saving straight back to a folder needs a Chromium browser with the File System Access API.
landing_faq_a_files: On Steam for Windows, look in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pal\Saved\SaveGames\<Steam ID>\<World ID>. Open the whole world folder, or a ZIP of it, so Level.sav and the Players folder load together.
landing_faq_a_free: Yes. Every feature is free, with no paywall, and the whole project is open source.
landing_faq_a_opensource: The code is public and auditable on GitHub, and nothing leaves your device.
landing_faq_a_platforms: Both. The browser editor handles Steam, Game Pass and dedicated server saves. The desktop app adds direct Game Pass folder access and server management.
landing_faq_a_safe: Your save is parsed locally, writing back to a folder is opt-in, and originals are backed up first. Save editing always carries some risk, so keep a copy of the world folder before you start.
landing_faq_a_signal: Yes. Signal, built into the desktop app, pairs a phone, tablet or any other browser with a QR code over an encrypted peer-to-peer connection. It streams a live map of your world and lets you edit saves and manage servers on that PC remotely.
landing_faq_a_upload: No. Everything runs in your browser. Your save never leaves your device.
landing_faq_a_which: Use the web version for zero-install editing anywhere. Use the desktop app for maximum performance and dedicated server features.

landing_signal_body: Signal pairs the desktop app with your phone, a tablet or any other browser over an encrypted peer-to-peer link. Watch the live map from anywhere, browse and edit the saves on your PC, and manage your dedicated servers, all without your save ever leaving your machine.
landing_signal_feature_edit_body: Browse the Steam, Game Pass and server saves on your PC and edit them in place. Only your edits cross the wire, never the save file.
landing_signal_feature_live_body: Players and pals move in real time on your phone, a tablet or a second screen, whether the world runs on a dedicated server or on your own PC.

landing_signal_point_broker_body: The pairing server only helps the two devices find each other. On a restrictive network, traffic falls back to a relay that carries encrypted data it cannot read.

mods_profile_inactive: You're editing {name}, which isn't active. These changes apply when it is active.
mods_order_ue4ss_hint: UE4SS loads these top to bottom, in the order mods.txt lists them.
mods_order_palschema_hint: With forced PalSchema order on, these load top to bottom.
mods_order_alphabetical_hint: The game loads these alphabetically by file name, so their order can't be changed here.
mods_order_empty: No mods of this kind in this profile.
mods_order_keyboard_hint: Focus a mod and press Alt+Up or Alt+Down to move it.
mods_order_force_palschema_hint: Numbers each PalSchema mod's folder (001_, 002_, …) so they load in the order above.
mods_order_force_ue4ss_hint: Leaves out each mod's enabled.txt, so only the order above decides.
mods_launch_started: Palworld is starting with the {profile} profile.
mods_launch_running: Palworld is already running. Close it before launching from PalStudio.
mods_launch_apply_failed: Palworld was not started because its mods could not be applied. The apply result explains why.
mods_launch_other_target: This world is linked to a profile of another game install. Link it to a profile of this install, or launch it from that install.
mods_launch_unsupported_platform: Launching isn't supported for {platform} installs yet.
mods_launch_unavailable: PalStudio can't find this install's game executable, so it can't start the game.
mods_launch_desktop_only: The game can only be launched from the PalStudio app on the computer it is installed on.
mods_launch_not_a_client: Only a game install can be launched.
mods_worlds_hint: Palworld can't be told which world to open. A link only decides which mods are applied when you launch that world from here.
mods_worlds_empty: No local worlds were found on this computer.
mods_upload_hint: The file is sent to the computer running PalStudio. Files up to {max} can be uploaded.
mods_upload_invalid_name: This file name can't be used. Rename the file and try again.
mods_upload_unsupported_type: This kind of file can't be uploaded. Choose a zip, 7z, rar, tar, gz, pak, lua, dll or .psmods file.
mods_upload_too_large: This file is larger than {max}, the most that can be uploaded.
mods_upload_protocol: The upload was interrupted by an unexpected reply. Try again.
mods_upload_expired: The upload expired on the computer running PalStudio. Try again.
mods_upload_corrupt: The file didn't arrive intact. Try again.
mods_upload_io: The computer running PalStudio couldn't save the upload: {message}
mods_upload_connection_lost: The connection dropped during the upload. Try again.
mods_upload_too_many: Too many uploads are in progress on the computer running PalStudio. Wait for them to finish, then try again.
mods_install_remote_denied: Over a remote connection, only an uploaded archive can be installed.
mods_export_include_archives_hint: The file gets larger, but someone without these mods can install them from it.
mods_export_path_placeholder: Full path ending in .psmods on the computer running PalStudio
mods_export_missing_archives: These mods' archives weren't kept, so the file can't install them:
mods_export_unresolved: These mods have no version to export and were left out:
mods_export_invalid_path: Enter a full path ending in .psmods, in a folder that exists.
mods_export_desktop_only: Choosing a location isn't available here. Enter a path instead.
mods_export_failed: The profile could not be exported: {reason}
mods_export_remote: Profiles can only be exported on the computer running PalStudio.
mods_import_path_placeholder: Full path to a .psmods file on the computer running PalStudio
mods_import_done: Imported {name}. It isn't active yet — activate it to apply its mods.
mods_import_following_current: Using your current version instead of the exported one:
mods_import_missing_not_in_library: not in your library, and the file doesn't include it
mods_import_missing_id_mismatch: the included archive installed as a different mod
mods_import_missing_install_failed: the included archive could not be installed ({code})
mods_import_disabled: Added but turned off, because this install can't use them:
mods_import_disabled_not_supported: this install has no place for this kind of mod
mods_import_frameworks: Made with these frameworks, which importing does not install:
mods_import_invalid_path: PalStudio can't find that file. Enter the full path to a .psmods file.
mods_import_invalid_archive: This file isn't a PalStudio mod profile.
mods_import_unsupported_format: This profile was made by a newer PalStudio. Update PalStudio to import it.
mods_import_failed: The profile could not be imported: {reason}
mods_import_failed_partial: The profile was created but not finished: {reason}
mods_import_desktop_only: Browsing for a file isn't available here. Enter the file's path instead.
mods_import_remote_denied: Over a remote connection, only an uploaded file can be imported.
mods_import_missing_extract_failed: the included archive could not be unpacked
mods_import_missing_io_error: the included archive could not be read
mods_import_missing_nothing_routed: nothing in the included archive could be installed
mods_import_missing_library_error: the included archive could not be added to your library
mods_import_missing_already_managed: a Steam-subscribed package with the same name is already in your library
mods_hazard_workshop_proxy_dll: A dwmapi.dll or xinput1_3.dll sits beside the Workshop UE4SS install and would start UE4SS twice.
mods_hazard_amity_legacy_folder: An old PSPAmity folder is still in the UE4SS mods folder.
mods_framework_error_docker: Frameworks for Docker servers are managed by the server image.
mods_framework_error_conflict: UE4SS is already installed the other way on this game; remove that install first.
mods_framework_error_mods_dir: This target's UE4SS mods folder is not where UE4SS will look for mods.
mods_framework_error_not_installed: It is not installed on this target.
mods_framework_error_rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again later.
mods_framework_error_unavailable: No release is available to install.
mods_framework_error_archive: The release archive could not be used.
mods_framework_remove_confirm: Its files are removed from the game. Mods that need it stop loading.
mods_framework_remove_confirm_ue4ss: UE4SS, PalSchema and Amity are removed from the game. Mods that need them stop loading.
mods_conflicts_none: No conflicts found in the active profile.
mods_conflict_missing_package: {mod} needs the Workshop package {dependency}, which is not enabled.
mods_conflict_gamepass: {mod} has {count} pak files Game Pass cannot load until they are converted.
mods_conflict_pak_overlap: {mods} change the same {count} assets. {winner} loads last and wins.
mods_conflicts_unreadable: Files that could not be checked ({count})
mods_conflict_unreadable_iostore: Already converted for Game Pass; its contents are not checked
mods_conflict_unreadable_version: The pak uses a format this version cannot read
mods_conflict_unreadable_not_a_pak: The file is not a pak
mods_conflict_unreadable_invalid_json: The file is not valid JSON
mods_conflict_unreadable_io: The file could not be read
mods_conflict_error_no_profile: This target has no active profile to check.
mods_live_none: No game has been checked for this install yet. Start Palworld with Amity installed.
mods_live_signatures_missing: Amity could not find some game functions: {names}
mods_live_unexpected_title: Loaded but not in this profile
mods_live_error_instance: That game connection no longer exists.
mods_live_error_remote: Game connections can only be changed on the computer running PalStudio.
mods_iostore_newer: Converted from {version}; a newer version is installed.
mods_iostore_error_platform: Only Game Pass installs need converting.
mods_iostore_error_not_convertible: This mod has no pak files to convert.
mods_iostore_error_already: This mod is already in the Game Pass format.
mods_iostore_error_tool: The converter could not be downloaded: {message}
mods_iostore_error_not_in_profile: Add the mod to the active profile first.
mods_iostore_error_local: Conversion only runs on the computer running PalStudio.
mods_live_bind_unknown: An install that no longer exists
mods_live_connections_remote: Game connections can be viewed on the computer running PalStudio.
servers_container_recreate_notice: This server's container will be recreated the next time it starts, so it can load pak mods. Your saves and mods are kept.
servers_state_unknown: PalStudio couldn't tell whether this server is running, so none of your changes were saved. Check that Docker is running and try again.
servers_update_apply_in_progress: Your changes were saved, but the server was not restarted because PalStudio is changing its mods. Restart it when that finishes.
servers_start_apply_in_progress: PalStudio is changing this server's mods, so it did not start. Try again when that finishes.
servers_delete_apply_in_progress: PalStudio is changing this server's mods, so it was not deleted. Try again when that finishes.
servers_relocation_pending: This server's mod folders were changed but the mods could not be moved yet.
servers_relocation_setup_failed: This server's mods were moved, but the server could not be set up afterwards.
servers_container_create_failed: The server's container could not be created: {message}
mods_conflict_untracked_hint: Untracked paks are in the game's pak folders but not managed by PalStudio.
mods_list_remove_from_profile_missing: This mod is no longer in the profile.
mods_in_use_title: {name} cannot be deleted while it is still used:
mods_in_use_enabled_hint: Turn it off in the enabled profiles first.
mods_in_use_apply_named: Apply {target} to remove the files of {name}
mods_discover_start: Search or browse to see Palworld mods from Nexus Mods.
mods_discover_premium_note: Direct downloads need Nexus Mods Premium. Without it, the file opens on the Nexus Mods site and comes back through your browser.
mods_discover_no_files: This mod has no downloadable files.
mods_discover_decisions_body: PalStudio could not route every file in {file} on its own.
mods_nexus_error_network: Nexus Mods could not be reached.
mods_nexus_error_rate_limited: Nexus Mods is rate limiting this app. It resets at {reset}.
mods_nexus_error_rate_limited_soon: Nexus Mods is rate limiting this app. Try again later.
mods_nexus_error_key_required: Add your Nexus Mods API key first.
mods_nexus_error_invalid_key: Nexus Mods did not accept that API key.
mods_nexus_error_keyring: The API key could not be reached in the system keyring.
mods_nexus_error_desktop_only: Nexus Mods features work only in the desktop app.
mods_nexus_account_anonymous: Browsing anonymously. Add your API key to download files and see your account.
mods_nexus_account_clear_confirm_message: You'll need to fetch a new key from the Nexus Mods site to add it back.
mods_nexus_account_profile: Open the Nexus Mods profile for {name}
mods_nexus_key_body: Paste your personal API key from your Nexus Mods account settings. PalStudio stores it in the operating system's keyring and never sends it anywhere except Nexus Mods.
mods_nexus_key_where: Open the Nexus Mods API key page
mods_nexus_handler_registered: PalStudio opens Nexus Mods download links.
mods_nexus_handler_unregistered: PalStudio does not open Nexus Mods download links yet.
mods_nexus_handler_unsupported: This platform cannot register link handlers yet.
mods_nexus_error_no_executable: PalStudio could not find its own program file to register.
mods_nexus_error_unsupported_platform: This platform cannot register link handlers yet.
mods_nxm_body: Nexus Mods asked PalStudio to download file {file} of mod {mod}.
mods_nxm_expired: That download link has expired. Start the download again on the Nexus Mods site.
mods_nxm_invalid: That link could not be read.
mods_nxm_unsupported: That link is not a Palworld mod download.
mods_nxm_no_targets: Add a game install before downloading mods.
mods_update_truncated: Only the first 50 mods were checked.
